brief:
An Israeli military operation in Hebron has displaced 537 Palestinian families, or 3,361 people, according to local officials cited by the Palestine News Network. The operation has also disrupted education for hundreds of thousands of students across the governorate.

Officials reported that the displacement has caused millions in daily losses, though a fuller accounting of the economic impact remains unclear as the operation continues.
